verdict.rationale: Kong (via Insomnia/Inso CLI) supports `inso lint spec` to lint OpenAPI specs and fail CI builds on errors, which covers basic spec linting; however there is no evidence of configurable custom style/governance rulesets (e.g., Spectral-like rule authoring, org-wide policy enforcement) beyond a pass/fail lint command. missing for 10: configurable custom governance rule definitions, evidence of rule customization or org-wide policy sets, independent corroboration of linting depth.
